Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using immunopurification of ITM2B. Acquisition is DDA (Top20 mode). Quantification is label-free (LFQ) using the Hi-3 method.

organism: Homo sapiens taxonomy was used for the MS/MS identification step
cell_types: These proteins are almost all exclusively expressed in photoreceptor cells
TUBB3 and the neurofilament light polypeptide (NEFL) both highly expressed in retinal ganglion cells
the well-known marker for Müller glial cells, Dickkopf-related protein 3 (DKK3)
ATP1B1 specific to amacrine cells and the septin-4 (SEPT4) specific to horizontal cells
cell_lines: The GripTite 293 MSR Cells (Thermo Fisher Scientific) were transfected
noncellular_sources: Postmortem human ocular globes from donors
The entire retina without the macula
scope: we performed quantitative proteomics of immunopurified ITM2B complexes isolated from normal human retinal protein extracts
Immunopurified protein complexes from each retinal sample were analyzed using LC–MS/MS
Proteins on beads from 3 experimental conditions (control, mouse antibody, rabbit antibody) were digested

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics analysis was performed on affinity-purified ITM2B complexes from human retina tissue. HEK 293 cells were used for validation experiments (immunoblotting/co-IP) but were not the primary source for the LC-MS/MS interactome discovery.
